Aisha (support): urgent — Customer [ACCT-REDACTED] reporting increased 5xx + timeouts from Hosted API since 09:12 UTC. They see spikes in 502/504 and heavy tail latencies.
Aisha (support): I pulled gateway logs, looks correlated with cache auth errors from memcached clients — snippet below. Customer impact: realtime chat feature failing, customer attached sample request/response.
Aisha (support): logs:
```
[09:12:07] gateway ERROR upstream=memcached-01 auth failed: AUTH failed - token invalid
[09:12:07] gateway ERROR route=/v1/generate status=502 backend=memcached-01
[09:12:09] gateway WARN stall forward: kv-get timeout (200ms)
[09:12:10] gateway ERROR route=/v1/generate status=504 backend=ensemble
```
Eli (oncall): copying in eng-infra. Do we know if there was a credential rotation recently? also any rollout around memcached client config?
Jordan (eng-infra): yes, we rotated memcached service account creds at 09:05 UTC during a routine KMS roll. Most nodes refreshed, but I'm seeing auth failure counts on a subset of edge clients. Likely propagation lag + some persistent connections didn't reauth.
Jordan (eng-infra): quick mitigation: force memcached client reauth / reconnect on affected frontends or disable auth requirement temporarily for the memcached pool (if safe).
Maya (sre): we should avoid disabling auth unless last resort. Immediate safe mitigation: flip route cache-bypass for the customer (set X-Bypass-Cache) so requests go direct to model backends — will cut the 5xxs but raise token costs. I can patch routing in Console now.
Aisha (support): customer accepted workaround if we can restore traffic quickly. Please confirm steps and ETA.
Eli (oncall): Jordan — can you push a client reconnect to the affected fleet? command I usually run: 
```
sudo systemctl restart redwood-memcached-client && sleep 2 && curl -sS http://localhost:8080/health
```
Jordan (eng-infra): doing rolling restart on the 12 edge boxes with high auth failures. will throttle to avoid cache stampede. ETA ~6m.
support-bot: ticket TCK-2026-504 created and linked to this thread.
Jordan (eng-infra): after restart auth failures drop to near 0, gateway 502s falling back to baseline. pushing config change to reduce persistent connection TTLs to avoid reauth lag in future.
Maya (sre): I applied cache-bypass for the customer route at 09:20 UTC. Confirming 200s on their test requests.
Aisha (support): customer confirmed regen of requests looks good, no more 502s for the last 3 minutes. Thanks team.
Eli (oncall): follow-ups: 1) postmortem on creds rotation procedure, 2) add automated client reauth trigger when rotation is detected, 3) add alert on memcached auth-failure rate > 0.5% for 1m.
Jordan (eng-infra): noted — will open infra task, target: add reauth hook + reduce connection TTLs.
Aisha (support): closing interim support escalation, keeping incident open until infra changes land. Will update customer with ETA.
Maya (sre): adding runbook note: if memcached auth-fail spikes during rotation -> 1) enable cache-bypass for impacted customer(s), 2) trigger client reconnects, 3) monitor for cache stampede, 4) roll connection-TTL change.
Aisha (support): thanks all :thumbsup:
